title: Australia news live: Chalmers says next election will be a ‘referendum on super’; new NSW laws to combat organised crime
text: 18.59 EDT Next election a referendum on super, treasurer says One Nation’s proposal for people to be able to divert some of their super into their pay packet is a “full-frontal attack” that will “make Australian workers tens of thousands of dollars worse off in retirement”, the treasurer, Jim Chalmers, said this morning. One Nation is “anti-worker” and they “vote the way that [billionaire backer] Gina Rinehart tells them to”, he said, adding that the next election will be a “referendum on super”: Every time One Nation is asked to support the financial interests of Australian workers, they oppose the financial interests of Australian workers. By ending super as we know it, by making Australian workers poorer as a consequence, One Nation is showing once again: this is exactly why One Nation poses an unacceptable and dangerous risk to Australian workers. Jim Chalmers last week. Photograph: Lukas Coch/AAP
author: Tory Shepherd

title: US envoys bring ‘more effective’ Ukraine peace proposals to Kyiv, official says
text: Advertising US envoys bring ‘more effective’ Ukraine peace proposals to Kyiv, official says Europe US envoys brought new, “more effective” proposals to Kyiv aimed at ending the war with Russia, a senior Ukrainian presidential official said on Sunday. President Volodymyr Zelensky and US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner described talks positively but announced no breakthrough, as Zelensky warned fighting could continue into winter. Issued on: 07/09/2026 - 02:31 Modified: 07/09/2026 - 02:33 3 min Reading time Share By: FRANCE 24 Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelensky, US Special Envoy Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner attend a joint press conference in Kyiv, September 6, 2026 © Genya Savilov, AFP Washington's envoys have brought new, "more effective" proposals on ending the war with Russia to Kyiv , a senior Ukrainian presidential official told AFP Sunday. Earlier Sunday, Zelensky had said the war with Russia looked likely to continue into the winter. While both he and the US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner had given upbeat assessments of the talks , neither announced any breakthroughs on ending the conflict. title: EU to boost Greenland investment amid Trump annexation claims
text: Advertising EU to boost Greenland investment amid Trump annexation claims Europe European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen is expected to announce increased EU investment in Greenland on Monday, including in critical minerals, satellite communications and renewable energy. Her two-day visit signals support for Greenland and Denmark amid US President Donald Trump’s push for American control of the Arctic territory. Issued on: 07/09/2026 - 02:27 2 min Reading time Share By: FRANCE 24 European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen in Greenland, September 6, 2026 © Mads Claus Rasmussen, Ritzau Scanpix, AFP European Commission President Ursula von der ​Leyen is expected to unveil on Monday a boost in EU investments in Greenland and closer political ties with the Danish Arctic territory, which Donald Trump has insisted should belong to the United States. text: Замена солдат и офицеров Планы южнокорейцев на современные технологии Тренд на военные системы искусственного интеллекта не обошел стороной и Южную Корею — правда, в отличие от соседей, пока здесь больше говорят о планах и стратегиях. Но все же и в Сеуле предлагают конкретные проекты, так как подобные платформы рассматриваются чуть ли не панацей от демографических проблем, влияющих на численность армии. Южнокорейцы запустили программу Defense AX Sprint — ускоренное внедрение гражданских ИИ-решений в вооруженные силы. До конца 2027 года на 20 проектов выделят около $29 млн ; направления охватывают боевое обеспечение, сокращение потребности в военнослужащих, кибербезопасность. 🔻 А что по конкретным проектам? ▪️ В их число входят автоматический анализ данных из открытых источников, создание трёхмерных карт по видео с беспилотников, прогнозирование поломок техники. Отдельно ведётся разработка единой системы управления разнородными беспилотниками через смартфон, которой занимается консорциум во главе с Samsung SDS. ▪️ Особое внимание уделяют демографическому вопросу .
